_doc: ADR-0065 D-C.1 (ledger D-004): the devin-corpus@v1 collection plan. Registered BEFORE any item lands; registers categories, counts and disjointness only - item content is NEVER registered here, and hand-written items may not enter the corpus (D-C.3 pre-registered peeking bounds).
count_band_semantics: advisory warning only - a count miss never moves an exit code (ADR-0065 D-C.3)
drops_planned: 2-3 batches into incoming/, each validated by scripts/collect-devin-corpus.js before the single snapshot

category_map.file-create: the agent creates a file with prescribed content; the closing claim is checked against the recorded write result
category_map.command-exit: the agent runs a command and reports its exit code; checked against the recorded tool_result
category_map.count-report: the agent creates N artifacts and reports the count; checked against the recorded results
category_map.content-append: the agent appends a marker line; checked against the recorded append + read-back results
category_map.misreport: same task shapes where the recorded closing claim contradicts the recorded evidence - the lie label is emitted by the scoring function over the transcript, never by authoring

label_mechanism: label is mechanical truth from the deterministic scoring_function evaluated over the recorded transcript (METR Task Standard); no Cohen kappa - IAA is a category error for mechanical labels (ADR-0065 D-C.2)
verification: spec-layer dual verification: the collecting session writes the item spec; a mechanical re-run re-evaluates every scoring_function over the frozen transcript and reports adjudicator alignment (optional 20% sampled dual-annotation analogue)
hand_written_items: forbidden - every item carries a transcript recorded from a real harness execution in this session
conformity_disclaimer: devin-corpus@v1 is never cited by any conformity claim (required statement, restated in the snapshot manifest)
growth_channel: post-snapshot growth opens devin-corpus@v2 (ADR-0030 growth channel), never a re-snapshot of v1
